name: Grade 7 IIT: Posters and Branding
description: Digital messages, environmental posters, Canva design, copyright-friendly images, branding, logos, palettes, typography, consistency, and feedback.

words.definition: The people a message or design is made for.
words.example: The poster audience was middle school students.

words.definition: The reason for creating a message or product.
words.example: The purpose was to promote recycling.

words.definition: A visual product that shares a message using text and images.
words.example: The poster had one clear title and image.

words.definition: A design tool used to create posters, slides, and visual products.
words.example: Students made their environmental poster in Canva.

words.definition: Difference between visual elements that helps them stand out.
words.example: Strong contrast made the title readable.

words.definition: Placing elements neatly along shared edges or lines.
words.example: Alignment made the poster look organized.

words.definition: How easy text is to read.
Allowed to use under clear rules without normal copyright limits.
words.example: The student chose a copyright-free image.

words.definition: A group of licenses that explain how people may use creative work.
words.example: A Creative Commons image still needs credit.

words.definition: A note naming the creator or source of media.
words.example: The image credit was placed below the poster.

words.definition: A consistent identity or style for a product, group, or campaign.
words.example: The brand used the same colors on the poster and slide.

words.definition: A symbol or design that represents a brand.
words.example: The logo matched the environmental theme.

words.definition: A chosen set of colors for a design.
words.example: The palette used green, white, and blue.

words.definition: The style and arrangement of text.
words.example: Typography helped the title stand out.

words.definition: Using the same design choices across related work.
words.example: Consistency connected the logo and slides.

words.definition: Helpful comments about strengths and improvements.
words.example: Peer feedback helped improve the poster.

words.definition: A change made to improve work.
words.example: The revision made the message clearer.

words.definition: The arrangement of text, images, and other parts.
words.example: The layout placed the title above the image.
